info.title: ExeMem Cloud API
info.description: Design-only OpenAPI. Nine product intents on POST /api/cloud/v3/{fetch,push,manage}. Tagged request/response unions by intent. No cloud storage resource names. Live home after implementation: cloud_backup_protocol/cloud-api.openapi.json.

payload_b64.description: Unpadded URL-safe base64 of the sealed envelope.

stream.description: ExeMem tags each entry. Publisher may see both; receivers only direct.

cursor.description: Opaque cloud-issued cursor for this entry.

node_key.description: Member node key. Storage row is grant#<node key>.

signed_grant.description: Publisher-signed grant bytes (opaque to ExeMem policy beyond verify).

cursor.description: Opaque. Absent = from start. Node sends no kind/filter.

part_handle.description: Opaque. When set, read that part.

part_handles.description: Opaque part handles for restore_part reads.

landed.description: Where ExeMem stored the append, from the caller's grant.

upload_url.description: Opaque short-lived upload URL. Treat as opaque (open question R1).

file_handle.description: Opaque handle returned on complete for later fetch/file.
